name: Nameless Maw Dragon - Young
description: Young Nameless Maw is a evil-leaning eclipsed intelligent true dragon with a gaunt wyvern form and burial-cloth wings. It seeks to consume identities, records, and recognition. At this age it is an emerging but formidable predator.

attacks.name: Maw and Talons
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (2)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 2 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Hushed Presence
abilities.description: The dragon cannot be located by sound alone; writing exposed to its breath fades until restored by a GM-approved means.

abilities.name: Breath of Erasure
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 16. On a failure, take 2d8+4 magic damage and the target cannot speak until its next action. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
